arxiv-2103-13417.title: Photometric Redshifts in the W-CDF-S and ELAIS-S1 Fields Based on Forced Photometry from 0.36 – 4.5 Microns
arxiv-2103-13417.creator: Fan Zou, Guang Yang, W. N. Brandt, Qingling Ni, Franz E. Bauer, Giovanni Covone, Mark Lacy, Nicola R. Napolitano, Kristina Nyland, Maurizio Paolillo, Mario Radovich, Marilena Spavone, Mattia Vaccari
arxiv-2103-13417.description: Abstract The W-CDF-S and ELAIS-S1 fields will be two of the LSST Deep Drilling fields, but the availability of spectroscopic redshifts within these two fields is still limited on deg 2 \mathrm{deg^{2}} scales. To prepare for future science, we use EAZY to estimate photometric redshifts (photo- z s) in these two fields based on forced-photometry catalogs.

arxiv-2302-01224.creator: Giorgio Bacci a emailA, Radu Mardare b emailB, Prakash Panangaden c emailC, Gordon Plotkin d emailD
arxiv-2302-01224.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Giorgio Bacci a emailA, Radu Mardare b emailB, Prakash Panangaden c emailC, Gordon Plotkin d emailD. Lawvere showed that generalised metric spaces are categories enriched over [ 0 , ∞ ] [0,\infty] , the quantale of the positive extended reals. The statement of enrichment is a quantitative analogue of being a preorder. Towards seeking a logic for quantitative metric reasoning, we investigate three [ 0 , ∞ ] [0,\infty] -valued propositional logics over the Lawvere quantale.

arxiv-2307-07090.title: Choice Models and Permutation Invariance: Demand Estimation in Differentiated Products Markets
arxiv-2307-07090.creator: Amandeep Singh, Ye Liu, Hema Yoganarasimhan
arxiv-2307-07090.description: Abstract Choice modeling is at the core of understanding how changes to the competitive landscape affect consumer choices and reshape market equilibria. In this paper, we propose a fundamental characterization of choice functions that encompasses a wide variety of extant choice models.

arxiv-2507-11730.title: Seeing the Signs: A Survey of Edge-Deployable OCR Models for Billboard Visibility Analysis
arxiv-2507-11730.creator: Maciej Szankin, Vidhyananth Venkatasamy, Lihang Ying
arxiv-2507-11730.description: Abstract Outdoor advertisements remain a critical medium for modern marketing, yet accurately verifying billboard text visibility under real-world conditions is still challenging. Traditional Optical Character Recognition (OCR) pipelines excel at cropped text recognition but often struggle with complex outdoor scenes, varying fonts, and weather-induced visual noise.

pmc-10521413.description: The Covid-19 pandemic has had serious medical, administrative and financial effects on the health system and hospitals around the world. pmc-11453528.title: 7311 Endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress and its associated signaling modulate incretin receptor signaling in pancreatic β cells
pmc-11453528.creator: J Lee
pmc-11453528.description: Disclosure: J. Lee: None.Pancreatic β-cell dysfunction and eventual loss are key steps in the progression of type 2 diabetes (T2D), and endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress and its associated signaling have been implicated in these β-cell pathologies. However, the precise molecular events surrounding ER stress and its signaling responses in β-cell dysfunction remain unknown.

pmc-11462281.title: Utility of ultrasound imaging in monitoring fracture healing in rat femur: Comparison with other imaging modalities
pmc-11462281.creator: Satoshi Inoue, Michinori Mori, Masaya Yasui, Miwako Matsuki-Fukushima, Kentaro Yoshimura, Naoko Nonaka
pmc-11462281.description: ObjectiveFractures are common injuries and various imaging modalities are employed to diagnose and monitor bone union. However, the follow-up of fracture healing using ultrasound imaging (US) remains a topic of debate. In this study, we analyzed of fracture healing process and compared US and radiological analyses with histological analyses to clarify the characteristics and limitations of each modality.

pmc-11523674.creator: Yosef Wube Habtewold, Mehammed Adem Getnet, Kalkidan Bazezew Genetu, Ashenafi Worku Woretaw
pmc-11523674.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionA sterile technique is a standard to reduce microorganism transmission during surgery. Gaps in knowledge and practice in sterile techniques by nurses are common causes of surgical site infections for surgical patients. Even though surgical site infection is a global problem due to lack of knowledge and practice, almost no study has been done in Ethiopia regarding nurses’ knowledge and practice of sterile techniques in the operating room.
